scope: A single resident frame restarted from native joint_chain trajectory states

box_geometry_roundoff.scale: max cuboid half-extent or relative translation component
box_geometry_roundoff.independent_check: Both endpoints lie on their respective box surfaces and the contact normal is unit length, in f64 validation of the f32 inputs.

preconditions: Freshly exported native ordinary-body snapshot at an explicitly recorded start frame; all physics and persistence buffers restored
One target frame, with existing geometry, four substeps, two biased PGS iterations and native bounded coloring
Frame counter and bounded current published counts must agree with the snapshot; previous contact graph and effective response are independently checked
invariants: Device-resident collision, canonicalization, adjacency, coloring, preparation, warmstart, solve, integration, finalization and persistence; no CPU physics between stages or frames
Integer identities, memberships, copied words, allocation bijections, read-only inputs and capacity guards are exact; legal atomic allocation order is compared semantically
Active body and constraint arithmetic uses the existing f32 absolute/relative tolerances
Each saved checkpoint checks finite normalized state, unchanged static bodies, bounded penetration and energy, and scene-specific restitution, settling or rolling behavior
Internal workspace above a published count may retain earlier-frame allocations; it is not interpreted as current state, and storage beyond the declared maximum capacity remains exact
Joint rows rebuild each substep and solve before contact colors in both biased and stabilization passes
Every frame is recorded on device and checked for static-body preservation, finite normalized state, bounded penetration/energy, locked anchor/rotation drift and limits
Motor energy allowance adds measured travel times the force cap; final target position is checked separately
Last recorded frame equals published body state exactly; frame count, storage guards and copied words remain exact
Every preceding and future trajectory word remains exactly unchanged; the new row equals published final state exactly
Position, geometry, matrix coefficients and identities retain their strict default checks; only one-frame velocity/impulse/joint-row arithmetic has an explicit 1e-4 absolute allowance
Contact basis must be orthonormal and inertia positive semidefinite; effective normal/tangent response is independently reconstructed from stored geometry in f64
outside_scope: Long trajectory accumulation; handled by the parent scene contract
Arbitrary runtime snapshots and unsupported rigid-body features
Ascend vendor compilation, execution and hardware synchronization qualification
tolerance_reason: The retained single-frame native snapshots isolate contact feedback. Only velocity, impulse/cache and joint-row fields use 1e-4 absolute / 2e-5 relative; geometry and poses keep 2e-6 / 2e-5. C and Metal diagnostics observed at most 6.04e-5 velocity and 9.19e-5 joint-row differences, with pose error below 1.4e-7 and contact error below 1.2e-7. Exact masks and independent physics remain mandatory.
